metadata.description: High-fidelity audit checklist for trust boundary edges in zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol

missing_from_property_catalog: EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH (same trust level - not a security boundary)
EDGE-NOVA-PROOFS-FETCHED (no dedicated boundary property in catalog)

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP: Validate all wrap request parameters from untrusted user input
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate LiquidityManager.wrap() function in contracts/LiquidityManager.sol
2. Verify that amount parameter is checked for > 0 before any state changes
3. Verify that msg.sender validation occurs (not address(0) check if applicable)
4. Confirm safeTransferFrom is used for underlying token pull (not raw transferFrom)
5. Verify no state changes occur before successful token transfer completion
6. Check for reentrancy protection via ReentrancyGuard or checks-effects-interactions pattern
7. Verify that wrap amount does not exceed reasonable bounds (if any max limits exist)
8. Trace all code paths from external entry to state mutation

executable_checks.assertion: Function wrap exists with external/public visibility
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom is used for token transfers
No reentrancy vulnerabilities detected in wrap function

executable_checks.command: Review wrap() for input validation order
executable_checks.assertion: All input validation precedes state modifications

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP-BOUNDARY to hold true in the code. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted. Security assumption from trust model: The LiquidityManager must validate all wrap request parameters including amount bounds, sender balance, and ensure the underlying token transfer succeeds before minting zERC20.

checklist.title: Verify that STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING correctly represents user token possession before wrap
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify that wrap() checks user's underlying token balance before attempting transfer
2. Confirm that allowance check occurs (either explicit or via safeTransferFrom revert)
3. Verify that wrap cannot proceed if user lacks sufficient underlying tokens
4. Check that ERC20 balance queries are performed correctly

executable_checks.assertion: Wrap reverts when user has insufficient underlying balance
Wrap reverts when user has insufficient allowance

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP-BOUNDARY -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING. This check verifies the precondition state that user must have underlying tokens before wrap can proceed.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-WRAP-REQUEST parameter sanitization at trust boundary
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Identify all parameters in wrap request (amount, recipient if any)
2. Verify amount is validated against overflow conditions
3. Check for zero-amount handling
4. Verify no unexpected parameters can be injected
5. Confirm data encoding/decoding is correct if using calldata

executable_checks.assertion: Maximum amount wrap handles correctly without overflow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-WRAP-REQUEST. This check ensures wrap request data is properly validated at the trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20: Token minting occurs only after wrap completion
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate zERC20 minting call within LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify minting occurs AFTER successful underlying token pull (safeTransferFrom)
3. Confirm no code paths allow minting without prior token receipt
4. Check that mint amount equals deposited amount plus any valid rewards
5. Verify atomicity - all operations complete or all revert
6. Ensure no callbacks or hooks can interrupt between transfer and mint

executable_checks.assertion: Mint call exists and follows transfer

executable_checks.command: Trace control flow from safeTransferFrom to _mint
executable_checks.assertion: No code paths allow mint without successful transfer
Wrap is atomic - either complete or fully reverted

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20, ensuring tokens flow from trusted to untrusted domain only after successful wrap. BOUNDARY - Trusted to Untrusted.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE is only reachable after all wrap preconditions satisfied
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Map all state transitions leading to wrap completion
2. Verify each transition requires proper precondition
3. Confirm wrap completion state is terminal for that operation
4. Check that event emission (Wrapped) occurs only at completion

executable_checks.assertion: Event emitted only after wrap completes

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20-BOUNDARY -> Node STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE. Verifies wrap completion state is properly gated.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP: Validate zERC20 balance and amount parameters
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate LiquidityManager.unwrap() function
2. Verify burn occurs BEFORE underlying transfer (burn-first pattern)
3. Confirm ERC20._burn validates balance >= amount
4. Verify no way to bypass balance check
5. Check fee calculation uses safe math with ceiling rounding
6. Ensure underlying liquidity check prevents over-withdrawal
7. Verify reentrancy protection on unwrap

executable_checks.command: Verify burn precedes safeTransfer in unwrap()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP-BOUNDARY to hold true in the code. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted. Security assumption: The LiquidityManager must validate unwrap amount against user's zERC20 balance, ensure sufficient underlying liquidity exists, and calculate fees correctly before burning tokens.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-UNWRAP-REQUEST prevents double-withdrawal attacks
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify burn is atomic with balance deduction
2. Check no reentrancy can occur between burn and transfer
3. Confirm insufficient liquidity reverts cleanly without partial state
4. Verify fee computation cannot underflow

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap reverts on insufficient zERC20 balance
Unwrap reverts on insufficient underlying liquidity

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-UNWRAP-REQUEST. Ensures unwrap request data prevents exploitation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER: Validate value <= 2^248-1 before hash chain update
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate zERC20 transfer function and _afterTokenTransfer hook
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant equals 2^248 - 1
3. Confirm value <= MAX_VALUE check occurs before hash chain update
4. Verify check uses correct comparison operator (<=, not <)
5. Ensure revert with ValueTooLarge error on violation
6. Check that all transfer entry points (transfer, transferFrom) are covered

executable_checks.assertion: ValueTooLarge error is defined and used

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER, ensuring BN254 field bounds are enforced. BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted. Cryptographic guarantee: BN254 field bounds.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-ZERC20-TOKEN hash chain integrity on transfer
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify hash chain update formula matches Nova circuit
2. Check SHA256(prevHash || to || value) truncation to 248 bits
3. Confirm hash chain update is atomic with balance update
4. Verify index increment is atomic and sequential
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-ZERC20-TOKEN. Ensures hash chain computation matches ZK circuit.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED: Event data integrity from trusted to semi-trusted
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify IndexedTransfer event contains all necessary fields
2. Confirm event parameters match storage values exactly
3. Check event is emitted after successful state changes
4. Verify Merkle proofs generated from events are verifiable on-chain
5. Ensure event cannot be forged by malicious actors
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED where trusted contract events flow to semi-trusted indexer. BOUNDARY - Trusted to Semi-Trusted. Security assumption: Events emitted by zERC20 are authoritative. Merkle proofs generated from indexed data are independently verifiable on-chain.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-INDEXED-TRANSFER-EVENT contains monotonic index for Merkle tree construction
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify index in IndexedTransfer event is strictly monotonic
2. Check index uses post-increment (index++) pattern
3. Confirm no index skips or duplicates possible
4. Verify index survives contract upgrade (if upgradeable)

executable_checks.command: Verify index increment is atomic with event emission
executable_checks.assertion: No skips or duplicates in index sequence

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-INDEXED-TRANSFER-EVENT. Ensures event indices support correct Merkle tree construction.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED: Cryptographic proof validation from untrusted user
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate proveTransferRoot() function in Verifier contract
2. Verify Groth16 verifier is called with correct verification key
3. Confirm proof verification occurs BEFORE transfer root storage
4. Check public inputs are correctly constructed and validated
5. Verify checkpoint reservation exists before proof accepted
6. Check for divergent proof detection (emergency state trigger)
7. Ensure all proof parameters are validated
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED. This check verifies the critical trust boundary EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 zkSNARK (128-bit). Security assumption: The Verifier must cryptographically verify the proof via IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() before storing the transfer root.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-GROTH16-PROOF public input binding prevents proof manipulation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify public inputs include all critical values (root, index, hash chain)
2. Check public inputs are reconstructed from on-chain state where applicable
3. Ensure user-provided inputs are validated against proof
4. Verify verification key matches deployed circuit

executable_checks.command: Audit public input construction in proveTransferRoot
executable_checks.assertion: All critical values bound in public inputs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-GROTH16-PROOF. Ensures proof cannot be manipulated via public input substitution.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-NOVA-IVC-PROOF to Groth16 conversion preserves soundness
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify Nova IVC proof is correctly converted to Groth16
2. Check that conversion uses correct circuit parameters
3. Ensure no information loss during conversion
4. Verify on-chain verifier matches off-chain circuit
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-NOVA-IVC-PROOF. Ensures IVC to Groth16 conversion maintains cryptographic soundness.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT: Only proven roots transmitted to Hub
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate relayTransferRoot() function in Verifier contract
2. Verify function reads from provedTransferRoots mapping
3. Confirm provedTransferRoots only populated after successful verification
4. Check LayerZero _lzSend is called with correct parameters
5. Verify message encoding matches Hub expectation
6. Ensure no way to relay unproven roots

executable_checks.assertion: LayerZero send is used for relay

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT where proven roots flow from trusted Verifier to semi-trusted LayerZero. BOUNDARY - Trusted to Semi-Trusted.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE encoding prevents cross-chain message manipulation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify message payload encoding is deterministic
2. Check encoding includes all necessary fields
3. Ensure receiver can validate message authenticity
4. Verify options bytes are correctly constructed
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE. Ensures cross-chain message integrity.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT: Validate sender EID against registered Verifiers
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzReceive() function in Hub contract
2. Verify srcEid is validated against registered verifier EIDs
3. Confirm invalid EID causes revert
4. Check message is properly decoded
5. Verify no way to bypass sender validation
6. Ensure LayerZero OApp pattern is correctly implemented
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT. This check verifies the critical trust boundary EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Semi-Trusted to Trusted. Cryptographic guarantee: LayerZero guardian supermajority. Security assumption: The Hub must validate the sender EID matches a registered Verifier before updating transferRoots.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE decoding and storage at Hub
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify message decoding matches encoding in Verifier
2. Check decoded root is stored correctly in transferRoots
3. Verify emitted event matches stored data
4. Ensure no data loss during decode
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE. Ensures message parsing maintains data integrity.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT: Broadcast same root to all Verifiers
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate broadcastAggregationRoot() function in Hub contract
2. Verify message payload is constructed ONCE before loop
3. Confirm same payload sent to ALL registered destination EIDs
4. Check no modification of payload during iteration
5. Verify aggregation computation uses PoseidonT3 correctly
6. Ensure sequence number is incremented atomically

executable_checks.assertion: Same payload sent to all Verifiers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT ensuring consistent global root broadcast. BOUNDARY - Trusted to Semi-Trusted.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT aggregation uses deterministic Poseidon tree
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify PoseidonT3 hash function is used for aggregation
2. Check tree construction is deterministic (same inputs = same output)
3. Verify aggregation includes all relevant transfer roots
4. Ensure sequence number provides ordering

executable_checks.assertion: Same inputs produce same aggregation root

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT. Ensures aggregation is deterministic.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL: Validate Hub EID before storing global root
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzReceive() function in Verifier contract
2. Verify srcEid is checked against configured hubEid
3. Confirm invalid Hub EID causes revert
4. Check global root is stored in globalTransferRoots after validation
5. Verify no bypass paths exist
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL. This check verifies the critical trust boundary EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Semi-Trusted to Trusted. Cryptographic guarantee: LayerZero guardian network. Security assumption: The Verifier must validate the message originates from the authorized Hub contract before storing global roots.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT enables cross-chain withdrawals after validation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify global root storage occurs after validation
2. Check teleport function can reference global roots
3. Ensure proper event emission for global root update
4. Verify sequence ordering is preserved

executable_checks.assertion: Global roots accessible for teleport validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT. Ensures global roots support cross-chain withdrawals.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC: Process untrusted IVC proof with validation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate prover service IVC proof reception endpoint
2. Verify IVC proof is deserialized with error handling
3. Confirm malformed IVC causes clean failure (not corruption)
4. Check prover is stateless per job (no cross-contamination)
5. Verify IVC is locally verified before Groth16 conversion
6. Ensure no private witness data is required from user

executable_checks.assertion: Jobs are isolated - no state sharing

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC where untrusted user input enters semi-trusted prover. BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Semi-Trusted. Security assumption: The Prover service must deserialize and locally verify the IVC proof before conversion. The prover cannot forge valid Groth16 proofs from invalid inputs.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-NOVA-IVC-PROOF contains only public commitments (no private witness)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify IVC proof structure contains only public data
2. Check private witness stays client-side
3. Confirm ZK property is preserved in proof transmission
4. Ensure prover cannot extract private inputs

executable_checks.assertion: Only commitments and public inputs transmitted

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-NOVA-IVC-PROOF. Ensures user privacy is preserved when submitting IVC proofs.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16: Proof delivery without modification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify prover returns Groth16 proof without modification
2. Check user can verify proof locally before submission
3. Confirm altered proofs fail on-chain verification
4. Ensure proof format matches on-chain verifier expectation

executable_checks.command: Review proof retrieval and local verification
executable_checks.assertion: User verifies proof before on-chain submission

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16 where proofs flow from semi-trusted prover to untrusted user. BOUNDARY - Semi-Trusted to Untrusted. Cryptographic guarantee: Local Groth16 verification.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-GROTH16-PROOF format compatibility with on-chain verifier
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify proof encoding matches Groth16Verifier expectation
2. Check point coordinates are in correct format
3. Ensure public inputs are properly ordered
4. Verify no padding or encoding issues

executable_checks.assertion: Valid proofs are accepted by on-chain verifier

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-GROTH16-PROOF. Ensures proof format compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT: Four-layer validation of untrusted parameters
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate withdrawWithProof() or teleport function in Verifier
2. Verify Layer 1: Root reference validation (proved or global roots)
3. Verify Layer 2: Recipient hash binding (Poseidon of chain_id, msg.sender, tweak)
4. Verify Layer 3: Monotonicity check (newTotal > currentTotal)
5. Verify Layer 4: Groth16 proof verification
6. Ensure ALL four layers must pass before minting
7. Check correct ordering of validations
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT. This check verifies the MOST CRITICAL trust boundary EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT. CRITICAL BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 zkSNARK. Security assumption from trust model: The Verifier must: (1) validate root reference against provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots, (2) verify recipient hash binding, (3) enforce strictly increasing totalTeleported for double-spend prevention, (4) cryptographically verify the Groth16 proof before minting any tokens.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-TELEPORT-REQUEST prevents double-spend via monotonicity
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify totalTeleported is strictly monotonically increasing
2. Check newTotal > currentTotal (not >=)
3. Confirm totalTeleported is updated BEFORE minting
4. Verify same proof cannot be replayed
5. Ensure totalTeleported is per-user or per-address

executable_checks.assertion: Same proof cannot be used twice

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-TELEPORT-REQUEST. This is the PRIMARY double-spend prevention mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify root reference validation rejects unknown roots
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify root lookup in provedTransferRoots mapping
2. Verify fallback to globalTransferRoots for cross-chain
3. Ensure zero/unknown roots cause revert
4. Check no default values can bypass check
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT-BOUNDARY -> Action ACTION-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF. Ensures only valid state transitions are accepted.

checklist.title: Verify recipient hash binds proof to msg.sender
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify recipientHash = Poseidon(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak)
2. Confirm hash is computed on-chain using msg.sender
3. Ensure different sender produces different hash
4. Verify hash is bound in proof public inputs
5. Check tweak prevents cross-chain replay

executable_checks.assertion: Proof usable only by intended recipient

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT-BOUNDARY -> Action ACTION-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. Prevents front-running and proof theft.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE: Validate user balance before cross-chain exit

2. Verify user's zERC20 balance is validated

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE. BOUNDARY - Untrusted to Trusted.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 precondition for bridge operation
checklist.detection_procedure:

3. Ensure atomic operation - no partial bridge possible

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE-BOUNDARY -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20. Ensures bridge preconditions are met.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES: Enforce slippage limits via Stargate

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES-BOUNDARY -> Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES. This check verifies the trust boundary EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES where assets flow from trusted Adaptor to semi-trusted Stargate bridge. BOUNDARY - Trusted to Semi-Trusted. checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES-BOUNDARY -> Data DATA-BRIDGE-PARAMS. Ensures bridge failures don't result in permanent fund loss.
